title: Cube transfer A → B on the shared table (experimental layout)
task: Demonstrate with the leader: move the cube from A to B on the shared table.
description: Experimental display layout: leader and follower mounted facing each other (ALOHA reference mounting convention). The operator demonstrates with the leader; the follower attempt is the joint-mapped replay of that demonstration, evaluated with the same rule. No retargeting, no hardware registration.

frame.name: STUDIO_DISPLAY_WORLD
frame.calibration: none: experimental display transform, not hardware registration

manipulator.frame: leader base_link mapped to the display world by the layout

task_point_provenance: Most central pair found by kkh.engineering.workspace_frames.search_task_points on the experimental_shared_table layout: both arms reach A and B with position IK (< 5 mm) and the gripper x-axis pointing down (< 5 deg). Collision, grasp orientation about the vertical and contact are NOT checked (reports/workspace_layout.json).

visual_grasp.gripper_measure: normalised leader finger opening (0 closed, 1 open)
visual_grasp.release: on opening, the cube drops vertically to the table surface
visual_grasp.orientation: ignored: attachment depends on fingertip position only

engineering_questions: Does a joint-space replay of the leader demonstration bring the follower to the cube on this mounting?
Which frame registration and retargeting are needed before a follower attempt can succeed?
